doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: First instruments and the harmonica
summary: Drums were his first instrument; he also played harmonica, guitar, piano and others, and Allen proposes recording him.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Let's start back at the beginning. That might make it come out in better order, you know? So what was your very first instrument you played? Drums.
Drums. That's the first thing I took off, but I played a lot of them used after that.
Yeah, I played harmonica, juice hop, flute, pipe, piccolo, baseball, guitar, piano.
Can you still play harmonica much?
You want to make some records? I think I can fix you up. I bring my boy around sometime.

Yeah, I can play. I don't know how I would make out with the new teeth. After I get you up some teeth, I can't make it take teeth out and play like that. But the harmonica I used to play is a marine band. Oh yeah?
I get a marine band receiver.
Well get in practice and phone me up at Tulane. You had to get in.
Yeah, you had to write it down.
Okay, we'll write it down. Hold on a second. What kind of guitar? You played a big wedding just with a…
